title: GND fact-type judgements
description: The gnd-type-judgements/1 file a judgement skill writes and `gnd discover --families fact-type --type-evidence-in EVIDENCE` reads with `--duplicate-judgements` or `--shape-judgements` (TS2). It binds one evidence file by the SHA-256 of that file's raw bytes and gives exactly one verdict per group the kind judges: `duplicates` judges the groups with status proposed, shape_match or over_budget (`distinct`, or `duplicate` of a candidate named in `of`); `shapes` judges the multi_valued groups (`many-to-many` or `skip`). The rules the CLI checks are in docs/reference/discover.md, section Type judgements.

skill.description: The skill that wrote the verdicts.

agent.description: Free text naming the agent or model; scanned for population values like a rationale.

generic.description: The group's generic fact type, as the evidence names it.

of.description: For a duplicate: the candidate fact type the group duplicates.

rationale.description: Why, in a sentence or two. Refused when it names a population value the disclosure mode hides.
